candidate_materials.name: Pr3+:Y2SiO5 (Teller et al.)
candidate_materials.feasibility: MEDIUM — state fidelities are available but no coherence curve. The Teller data provides endpoint fidelities, not L(t). A bath validation would need a separate coherence measurement.
next_steps: Extract the Y2SiO5 crystal structure from the Teller data
Identify 89Y nuclear spins (I=1/2, 100% abundance) as the bath
Compute hyperfine couplings for Pr3+ in Y2SiO5
Find or measure a coherence curve L(t) for Pr3+:Y2SiO5
Run the convergence study and compare

candidate_materials.name: Pr3+ (Rodriguez-Moldes et al.)
candidate_materials.feasibility: MEDIUM — coherence curves are available (T2 decay data) but no crystal structure or hyperfine couplings. The T2 data provides L(t) but not the bath parameters needed to compute L(t) from first principles.
next_steps: Obtain the crystal structure for the Pr host material
Run the convergence study with the experimental conditions
Compare computed L(t) against the Rodriguez-Moldes T2 data

candidate_materials.name: NV/13C diamond (Bradley et al.)
candidate_materials.feasibility: HIGH — diamond crystal structure is well-known, 13C bath is well-characterized, NV hyperfine tensor is computable, and Bradley provides Ramsey/echo data. This is the best candidate for a full material-specific bath validation.
next_steps: Obtain the Bradley et al. data from 4TU.ResearchData
Build a 13C bath around the NV center using the diamond lattice
Compute the NV hyperfine tensor (or use literature values)
Run the convergence study at the experimental conditions (temperature, field)
Compare computed L(t) against Bradley Ramsey/echo data
If convergence and coherence match, issue a convergence certificate
Run the protocol test with the material-specific profile

recommendation.rationale: The NV center in diamond is the best-characterized system among the candidates. The crystal structure is known, the 13C bath is well-modeled, the NV hyperfine tensor is available in the literature, and Bradley provides experimental Ramsey/echo data for comparison. This is the most direct path to a material-specific bath validation.
blockers: Bradley data not in local cache — need to download from 4TU.ResearchData
Need to build a 13C bath model with realistic positions
Need to verify the convergence study passes at the experimental conditions
Need an independent review before labelling as a material prediction
recommendation.estimated_effort: 1-2 weeks for the bath model and convergence study; additional time for independent review
